definitions.explanation: The fundamental force or motivation that causes something to move, develop, or progress. Used both literally for mechanical power and figuratively for motivation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{好奇心|こうきしん}→好奇心：05213_koukishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原動力|げんどうりょく}だ。
examples.english: Curiosity is the driving force behind growth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}{革新|かくしん}→技術革新：12892_gijutsukakushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原動力|げんどうりょく}になった。
examples.english: Technological innovation became the driving force of economic development.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧{原動力|げんどうりょく}になっている。
examples.english: Love for his family is what drives him to keep going.

notes:
Composed of {原|げん} (original/source), {動|どう} (movement), and {力|りょく} (force). Originally a mechanical/physics term for motive power, but now far more commonly used figuratively to describe what motivates or drives progress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原動力|げんどうりょく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become the driving force
- {原動力|げんどうりょく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as the driving force (more formal)
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原動力|げんどうりょく}: the engine of the economy
- ⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原動力|げんどうりょく}: the driving force of growth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{動力|どうりょく}→動力：18784_douryoku⟧: power, motive force — more technical/mechanical
- ⟦{推進力|すいしんりょく}→推進力：15905_suishinryoku⟧: propulsion, driving force — emphasizes forward movement
- ⟦モチベーション→モチベーション：06184_mochibeeshon⟧: motivation — loanword, used for personal motivation
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: cause — simply what caused something, without the implication of ongoing energy
